errors.404: exact selected node unavailable or ambiguous

operations.bounds: at most four exact node lookups after the shared snapshot/index is prepared; cold graph construction is separate
operations.comparison_law: inclusive normalized envelopes; equal first, strict before/after, inclusive contains/contained-by excluding equal, otherwise overlaps (including shared boundaries). Same explicit time role and exact certainty required. No calendar conversion, relative-anchor resolution, uncertainty expansion, duration or historical-truth inference.

profiles.all: exact carrier traversal including detailed text units, anchors and record-production links; the same limits apply
profiles.overview: source-filtered carriers of one declared ToS ID expand at zero distance before a relation hop, within node budgets; excludes dense text-unit/anchor membership and typed record-maker/provenance links; shared record production is not semantic proximity

operations.result: a bounded radial LensResult centered on an exact normalized ID, stable entity ID, or one unambiguous native ID
operations.resolution: exact normalized ID first; then stable entity ID with deterministic source priority; an ambiguous native ID is rejected and must be disambiguated through search

operations.result: stored LensSpec executed through the generic engine
validated arbitrary tos_lens_spec_v1 executed without changing ToS
operations.post_semantics: POST carries a structured read query only; it creates no server state and performs no write

extensions.packet_form_source: equal exact roles.<role>.form; inline packet form is forbidden in v2 base/delta
extensions.consumer_law: Keep the raw versioned envelope; reconstruct complete packets before semantic consumption and apply existing exact form, subject, revision, context and admission checks. Deltas are never standalone wording or a new admission.

extensions.state: disposable bounded query checkpoints: local process memory or shared D1 cache; no authored writes

errors.400: invalid request or sources exclude origin closure
errors.409: snapshot or selected content changed; restart
errors.413: D1 checkpoint capacity exceeded; narrow scope/page
errors.503: migration/read model not prepared or corrupt origin closure

authority_limit: Lens execution selects and composes existing ToS material; it cannot author meaning, review, rights, or canon.
